_comment: PostToolUse fixture for tt-ff-exit-monitor. Simulates get_market_metrics(detail='full') response for AAPL, SPY, and ES. Positions file is set up externally by the test runner. Three scenarios are exercised via different positions setups: (1) AAPL calendar with FF < 0 → WARN; (2) SPY calendar with FF > 0 → silent; (3) no calendars → silent. Earnings dates: AAPL 2026-05-10 (within front May16 window), SPY 2026-05-25 (within back Jun20 window). ES has contango term structure (Jun20 IV=16% < Sep19 IV=20%) so a cross-contract /ESM6//ESU6 calendar produces FF < 0 → WARN.
